reader.requirement: At --std 85, every literal operand of DIVIDE formats 1-5 (literal-1 and literal-2) must be a numeric literal or, by §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3, the figurative constant ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES (ALL being redundant at 1985); a nonnumeric literal, ALL literal, SPACE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, QUOTE or symbolic-character is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry figurative-all-zero-numeric-removed-2002: ALL ZERO as a numeric-literal operand is accepted at 1985 (ALL redundant) and refused with COBOL0902 from 2002

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: ALL ZERO(S) in a literal slot is accepted at 1985 and refused at 2023; every other operand class is treated alike
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb155-divide-figurative (SPACE in format 1) and pb155-add-string-literal (ADD, not DIVIDE); not exercised: literal-2 slots, formats 2-5, HIGH/LOW-VALUE, QUOTE, ALL literal, symbolic-character, ZERO and ALL ZERO acceptance

probes.expected: numeric literals (signed, decimal) and ZERO/ZEROS/ZEROES/ALL ZERO accepted in literal-1 and literal-2 of all five formats; division by ZERO takes ON SIZE ERROR

probes.printed: ten COBOL0844 errors, one per statement: "2", SPACE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUES (literal-2), QUOTE, ALL "1" (literal-2), symbolic-character STAR, "3" (format 5 literal-2), "10" (format 4 literal-2), SPACES
probes.expected: each refused: not a numeric literal and not ZERO
18-digit literals (the 1985 maximum), negative literal, zero divisor and an overflowing quotient behave per VI.6.11.4

probes.printed: --std 85: +0000; --std 2023: error COBOL0902 ... ALL ZERO ... removed in COBOL-2002
probes.expected: 1985 admits ALL ZEROS (ALL redundant, IV.4.2.2.2.3 rule 3); 2023 does not

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.11.3 SR2  (6.11.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2
OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in the clause; it lies in SRL3.1

reader.notes: The grammar is a superset (sendingOperand / arithmeticPhraseOperand); the binder's one numeric-context literal reading refuses every non-numeric literal and figurative except ZERO, and the ALL ZERO edge is the one edition-gated arm. Diagnostics cite §2023:8.8.1.1, not the 1985 rule.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.11.2 formats 1-5 and IV.4.2.2.2.3 exceptions (1) and (3). Probes --std 85: r6flt DIVIDE 1.5E1 INTO X refused COBOL0900 (floating-point literal is 2002); r6big 19-digit and r6big2 20-digit literals refused COBOL0802 (not a 1985 numeric literal, 18-digit maximum); r6all0 DIVIDE ALL "0" refused COBOL0844 (ALL literal is not ZERO); r6hex X"31" and r6nat N"1" refused COBOL0844 + COBOL0900; r6ok DIVIDE -.5 INTO X and DIVIDE 4 INTO +8 GIVING Q print -000000200.0000 +000000002.0000. (A first batch used S9(18)V9, 19 digits, my error; rerun with S9(9)V9(4).) cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.6.11.3 SR2  (6.11.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in the clause; it lies in SRL3.1'.
